Needs changes before merge.

The menu actions use the existing undoable commands. They delete the clicked model or tool, even when another item is selected. The four new tests pass. They check deletion, undo, redo, invalid targets, and the existing missing-tool block.

Results merged with main, locally:

- Reviewed head: `3962e985b04f9be2daabce78f8e60d1a3888170e`.
- Upstream main: `06d349391ca27e193a943fb37c51380e2c283f95`.
- The trial merge was clean. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all 17 steps passed, including the build with `--no-run`.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff upstream/main --check`: passed.

Extra suites run: none. The PR changes no test data, fixture directory, golden directory, or importer. The extra test-selection rules do not apply.

Heavy lanes: `gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reports that the diff reaches no heavy lane.

Safety scope: the PR changes UI routing to existing commands. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision check, gouge check, or stock simulation. No goldens moved. Reviewer mutations: not required and not run. The author reports mutations in the PR body; I did not repeat them.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/fixture_menu.rs:48` and `:64`: Add before/after screenshots of the model and tool context menus to the PR body. The UI review requires these screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not add the images to the PR branch.

Notes, not blocking:

- `state.rs` grows by two lines and `egui_app/tests.rs` grows by one line. Both files already exceed the 400-line guide. This remains existing code debt.
- The existing SolidCraft import test passed after more than 60 seconds. Manual desktop interaction and release-only pixel snapshots were not exercised.
- No process file changes. No dependency changes. No new command or MCP tool is needed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Added before and after screenshots of the model and tool context menus to the PR body.

The four images are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `eb29179fb195ceb74de223465db521f0691bae7c`.
The PR body links to that immutable commit.
The captures use the offscreen UI harness with the parent menu behavior and the reviewed head.
Capture assertions check that Delete is absent before and present after.
The screenshot-link pin failed on the original body, passed on the updated body, failed with one image removed, and passed after restoration.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 17 steps.
`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
All temporary capture code was removed. The PR branch has no new files or commits.
The current head remains `3962e985b04f9be2daabce78f8e60d1a3888170e`.

Please re-review this head and the screenshot links in the PR body.
